build_Concatenate_component: build a Concordia agent component that concatenates pre-act values from multiple named components
create_Concatenate_with_label: create a Concatenate component with a custom pre-act label and list of component keys
get_component_pre_act_label: get the pre-act label string of a named component from the parent entity
make_pre_act_value: make a concatenated string of all component pre-act labels and their values
get_state_set_state: get or set the serialized state of a Concatenate component including its component keys
